review_basis: Final PNGs visually inspected panel by panel and as complete figures; equivalent PDF geometry independently audited. Re-rendered scientific artifacts are byte-identical.

panels.unique_inference: All-extracted and unmatched mean-change intervals cross zero; matched intervals are positive under both age origins.
panels.interval: All six contrasts show the registered 95% percentile chapter-composition ranges.
panels.geometry: Both source-origin and cutoff-origin marks and their full intervals are visible; no clipping, no redundant significance stars.
panels.labels: Three matching-status rows, separate axis units and one shared two-origin legend; circle/square fill encodings survive grayscale.

panels.unique_inference: Positive within-matched contributions combine with negative within-unmatched and matching-composition terms; the decomposition is algebraic.
panels.interval: All six component estimates show the corresponding pooled chapter-composition ranges.
panels.geometry: Source and cutoff origins have a common within-panel axis; panel b uses a separately labelled contribution scale.
panels.labels: Every component has a direct row label; color/shape encodings match panel a.

panels.unique_inference: The D2 contrast follows different conditional paths when unknowns tilt to the largest source or to distinct sources.
panels.interval: None; deterministic allocation model, not uncertainty or LLM source classification.
panels.geometry: Both full parameter paths and the zero line are visible. No smoothing or unreported interpolation was applied.
panels.labels: Two direct legend labels, solid/dashed encoding and explicit allocation parameter.
panels.conditioning: Unknown source/type IDs are assumed journal-eligible. Known other types are excluded; this is not an identified journal-only population estimate.

warning_reviews.resolution: PNG/PDF/SVG only are expressly required by the user; TIFF is intentionally not generated.
133 mm is the fixed manuscript figure contract; 89/183 mm are generic Nature defaults, not the target journal specification. Root must place at natural size or verify any scaling.

main_alignment: PASS, shared rendered left/right edges and widths; no exemptions
